page.content:
Nelson Andrews, known as Fuya Okudaira (奥平風也, Okudaira Fūya) in the Japanese version, is a child actor and one of the "Number" holders in Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL.

page.overview:
Who is Nelson Andrews?

Nelson Andrews, known as Fuya Okudaira (, Okudaira Fūya) in the Japanese version, in the Japanese version, is an opponent in Yu-Gi-Oh! Millennium Duels. This is a video game depiction of Nelson Andrews, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL anime.
